name: sprint-status-reporter
description: Reports on the current sprint from any supported tracker (Azure DevOps, Jira) three ways. /run tallies work items by state (Done / In Progress / To Do), computes percent complete and remaining count, flags blocked and stale items, and emits a Marp deck. /progress-delta compares the sprint now against an earlier snapshot (or reconstructed history) and reports what shipped, what newly started, scope added or dropped, new risk, and how progress moved. /pulse publishes the same metrics and delta into a private, always-current Claude Artifact dashboard, one tile per ticket label with an active and a closed count plus a paste-ready Copy for deck view, and refreshes that same dashboard on every later run, so status is available between report days. Pulse accepts a --from/--till or --range date window and a --status filter to bound which closed and new tickets show, while active tickets always show in full. Every run writes a snapshot so deltas accumulate. Read-only and safe to run anytime; no tracker writes, no confirmation gate. Tracker-agnostic via issuekit. Bundles sprint-analyzer, deck-composer, delta-analyzer, delta-narrator, and dashboard-composer skills.
